title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes IV
notes: The designer's fourth Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#4285). Flashback: a play by Flashback from the graveyard costs at least (1) after every discount, printed or lent, at each embiggen price and an X card's (R4285000); field permissions and graveyardPrice plays take no floor. The Great De-Keywordification: the 53 Starship Pieces lose Equip, and Jlockeed's Missile Pod and Mindustrial Cross-over give Starship Piece alone; Equip picks still fuse them (R4285001). Spectre loses Flexible; Jade Beauty is Evasive instead of Indestructible and Immutable. Stat, cost and param changes on about 25 cards. Script changes, each keeping its v0.6.7k script (R767000): Jlockeed's Missile Pod splits its Attack among random enemies (R4285002), Halo Discovers once and fuses the pick twice (R4285003), Tatches the Totem summons itself from the deck alone (R4285004), Wildar's cards cost (1), Profe Yates summons one Trap (three non-Radiant on its Radiant face), Mindustrial Cross-over, and Call to Chaos (Meditative Edition). Call to Chaos (Meditative Edition), the designer's 'nerf the out of line modes by about 20%': no record holds per-mode data (a game records the card, not the entry rolled, and every Call to Chaos edition's shipped win rate sits within two points of the others), so the four entries that hand out value for nothing are cut: the fused hand and its copy, the 2 CN cards and the 2 Prime cards cost (1), from (0), and the hero's Armor and heal are 3, from 4; the other six entries are unchanged (R4285005). Halo's Radiant 6/1 is R275's named exception (R4285006). Rulings R4285000-R4285006. xxFreshJack and Shockwave447 play differently, their BUSTED and complicated pools following the changed scripts' code lines (R2173001).

changes: Flashback: playing a card from your graveyard by Flashback costs at least (1), after every discount, at each of its prices. From your hand it costs what it costs.
No Starship Piece has Equip any more: each is played into a zone of its own and still fuses into your Dormant Starship when it dies. Orca, Phalanx and Halo still Equip their picks.
Jlockeed's Missile Pod: at the end of your turn it deals damage equal to its Attack (Radiant: twice its Attack), split one at a time among random enemies. Embiggened, it is a Starship Piece only.
Mindustrial Cross-over gives its card Starship Piece only.
Halo's Cry: Discover a Rare Weapon (Radiant: an Epic one) and Equip it into Halo twice.
Tatches the Totem no longer summons itself from your hand, only from your deck.
